holdout_policy: Live adaptation uses observable recent labels, including dates beyond the retired research holdout boundary. Existing frozen experiments are preserved; the live model is not eligible for evaluation on those consumed labels. Future forecasts are evaluated only after publication.
quality_policy: Track breadth and magnitude of improvement, directional accuracy, high/low error, ranking value and downside. No unanimous-seed or significance gate for a daily watchlist. Roll back only on engineering failure; preserve baseline and audit evidence.
ranking: Published rank uses sell_reference_price / buy_reference_price - 1 - cost. Preserve the selected reference date and per-model-median reference prices. Pathwise mean ideal returns remain diagnostics only; they do not rank the published watchlist.
